name: typedgraph
description: Typed, signed, labeled property graph for Obsidian: openCypher queries, edge properties, LadybugDB mirror, vector search, GraphRAG and MCP.

paragraphs: Your Obsidian notes as a real graph: typed, signed, labeled edges with properties, openCypher queries, a graph view that shows what it means, and RAG-ready storage for agents.
Obsidian links say that two notes are related, not how. Typed Graph lets one line say how:
Then you can ask the vault questions in openCypher, inside any note:
features: Typed, signed edges with properties. type:: [[Target]] {props} works like Graph Link Types, so your existing lines keep working. A - prefix makes an edge negative, and edges can have stable or pinned ids.
Typed nodes and schema notes. Frontmatter type gives a note its labels. A note in Types/ declares a type's properties, allowed edges, template and look.
openCypher queries. MATCH, OPTIONAL MATCH, WITH, aggregates, variable-length paths and path variables. Queries are read-only and errors are clear.
Graph or table, live. Results render as a labeled, styled graph or a table, and refresh as you edit.
Edge embeds. {{edge: Alice -knows-> Bob . since}} shows an edge's property inside your prose.

whatItDoes.text: Your Obsidian notes as a real graph: typed, signed, labeled edges with properties, openCypher queries, a graph view that shows what it means, and RAG-ready storage for agents.

requirements.text: Code points at docs with // @lat: [[section]] (a plain link) or a typed edge, // @tg: implements:: [[auth#Login]] {since: 2}. tg mcp serves the same commands to agents over MCP.
Sign in at community.obsidian.md with your Obsidian account, and link your GitHub account to prove you own the repo.
